messages:
Ella (Marketing): Drafting the launch blog post now — pulled in benchmark numbers and webinar CTA. Need quick passes: legal on claims, demand gen on gating + HubSpot fields, growth on hero copy. Can we lock copy by EOD Tue? :party_parrot:
Sam (Product): Thanks — can you paste the exact benchmark language here? need to double-check the comparison baseline (open-source baseline vs. our optimized runtime).
Ella (Marketing): Sure — snippet from draft:

"In our internal benchmarks, Redwood Inference reduced end-to-end token cost by up to 48% compared to the baseline PyTorch FP16 runtime on 8k context workloads, while maintaining output quality within a 1–2% BLEU-equivalent score delta."

Also adding hero CTA: "Try the low-latency demo + join the launch webinar".
Mira (Legal): Flag — that "up to 48%" phrasing is risky without methodology + dataset. Please attach the benchmark runbook and the exact command lines/seed. Prefer "up to" only if we can back it with method and full disclosure. Otherwise suggest softer phrasing e.g., "as much as 48% in our tests" + link to methodology.
Jake (Demand Gen): For webinar gating: do we want registration required to get the benchmark slides, or open access and gated whitepaper? My recommendation: gated slides + follow-up nurture. If gated, we need HubSpot hidden fields to capture campaign + model interest. Example mapping I use:

```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=redwood_inference_launch
hubspot_form:
  formId: "hs_launch_2026"
  hiddenFields: ["utm_source","utm_campaign","model_interest","account_size"]
```

That way post-reg flow can auto-tag lifecycle stage. Also confirm webinar date so I can build the funnel.
Leo (Growth): Hero copy note — try a short A/B: (A) "Lower inference cost, predictable latency" vs (B) "Production LLM inference that scales reliably". We should pick a primary KPI for the test (clicks -> regs). Target: 8% CTR -> 18% reg rate baseline.
Nat (Ops): Publish logistics — proposed publish window Thu 09/12 09:00 PT; embargo for partners at 08:30 PT. I can queue the publish runbook but need the final URL path and canonical. Also confirm if we want a /blog vs /product path.
Ella (Marketing): Timeline: lock copy Tue EOD; legal signoff Wed morning; demand-gen builds funnel Wed afternoon; preflight Thu morning; publish Thu 09:00 PT. URL: /blog/redwood-inference-launch (open to feedback).
Mira (Legal): Please attach the runbook and raw logs. If the benchmark used specific hardware/quantization settings, they must be disclosed in a methodology appendix or caption. Also prefer "in our tests" language. I can OK the claim if we add a link to the runbook and replace absolute wording with contextual wording.
Sam (Product): I'll paste the runbook link here shortly and confirm the baseline command. For visibility: we compared against pytorch-run --fp16 --no-xformers on an A10G cluster, batch=1, seq=8192. Will add exact script in the runbook.
Jake (Demand Gen): Copy ask: can we include a short lead magnet copy for the registration modal: "Get the benchmark slides + optimization checklist". Also confirm HubSpot formId and the redirect URL after submit. :+1:
Ella (Marketing): Good. Draft the modal copy and the HS form config and drop it here by Wed AM.
Leo (Growth): Small ask — add a UTM snippet to the post CTA so we can separate blog vs homepage referrals. Example: 

/blog/redwood-inference-launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=launch_q3

I'll wire that into the A/B.
Nat (Ops): Publish runbook checklist (short):
- final copy locked in CMS
- canonical set + open graph image uploaded
- CTA UTM applied
- hs form configured + test submission
- embargo/unlock times scheduled
- CDN purge after go-live

I can do the run through Wed 17:00 PT.
Ella (Marketing): Mira — attaching the runbook now (internal link). Also added the benchmark appendix at the bottom of the draft. Changed headline per Leo A/B options so content teams can pick.
Mira (Legal): Reviewing appendix now. One more legal tweak suggestion for sentence: replace "maintaining output quality within a 1–2% BLEU-equivalent score delta" with "while maintaining comparable output quality in our automated evaluations (see methodology)" — less absolutist. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Product): Pasted the exact command and seed in the runbook. Also included the model variants tested and quantization notes.
Jake (Demand Gen): Final HS snippet I dropped for QA:

```
formId: "hs_launch_2026"
hiddenFields: {
  "utm_source": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "redwood_inference_launch",
  "model_interest": "inference_platform"
}
redirect: "/thank-you/launch-slides"
```

Can ops test a submission and confirm redirect?
Nat (Ops): Will run a test Wed 17:00 PT and report back.
Ella (Marketing): Quick checklist for approvals: Mira -> wording change accepted? Jake -> form + modal copy ready? Leo -> confirm A/B copy by Wed noon? Nat -> publish test Wed 17:00?
Mira (Legal): Wording change accepted pending appendix link in live post.
Jake (Demand Gen): Form + modal copy ready. I'll QA after ops test.
Leo (Growth): A/B copy confirmed.
Nat (Ops): Ops test scheduled and will post results here.
publish-bot: Scheduled publish job queued: 2026-09-12T09:00:00-07:00 (blog/redwood-inference-launch).
Ella (Marketing): Thanks all — locking timeline. Please react when you complete your task. :thumbsup:
